body.text: Run start 2026-11-22T15:23:04Z, per status. Reconstruct both plug interactions from the full demonstration. Use the calibrated white plug geometry to link the hand and object tracks, then reserve the first delivery window for feasibility and the first gated neural policy.

body.summary: Full 436-frame two-adapter reconstruction in a shared metric scene with calibrated tabletop, moving camera, rigid adapter poses, and MANO right hand. The structural reference check is VALID. Physical checks expose contact and hand fit limits.

components.name: scene analysis
components.method: Frame-by-frame event annotation and explicit support and contact checks
components.note: Contact timing and support are identified. Several phases fail the opposed-contact reconstruction check.

components.name: camera
components.method: White-housing PnP with MoGe-informed focal and background feature tracking
components.note: End-of-video camera estimate is weaker after many initial features leave the image.

components.name: white adapter geometry and physics
components.method: Blender mesh from station dimensions and separate blade colliders
components.note: Mass, material and friction are assumptions informed by comparable adapters.

components.name: black adapter geometry and physics
components.method: Blender mesh with housing fit to both supported configurations under a shared scale
components.note: Exact make, mass and contact properties are unresolved.

components.name: object 6D motion
components.method: Support-constrained silhouettes, prong lines, and continuous world-space smoothing
components.note: 436 white frames and 357 black frames directly used as valid; out-of-view black frames are marked invalid.

components.name: hand motion
components.method: HaWoR initialized MANO fit with the provided default optimizer and SAM 3.1 masks
components.note: 360 supported right-hand frames. Anatomical self-penetration check failed.

components.name: contact phases
components.method: Manual marking from all video frames, and hand–object geometry check
components.note: Thumb opposition is visible in the clip and unresolved by the fit for most of the turns.

components.name: comparison and validation
components.method: Synchronized 3-panel render, independent reprojection and geometry checks
components.note: Reference contract is VALID; the physical quality checks record specific failures.

limitations: Finger self-intersection fail (47.2%); white in-hand turn has no anatomically supported opposed grasp in this MANO fit, despite opposed digits visible in video.
Black adapter has 79 invalid frames during occlusion; late camera tracking uses few original background landmarks.

reprojection.note: against your own masks: agreement with them is necessary, not sufficient (3D errors along the viewing ray are invisible here)

anatomical_contact.note: a grasp needs the thumb and an opposing finger on opposite sides of the object; single-finger pushes or palm support are legitimate but must be stated in the analysis. Low penetration does not imply contact.

penetration_hand_object.note: unsigned (lower bound) distances where the object mesh is not watertight

self_penetration.note: triangle intersections between different fingers (FCL); counts are not volumes

physics.note: free-flight intervals are given with --flight OBJ=a:b; rest intervals default to object intervals without contact

handedness_scale.note: left/right are the demonstrator's anatomical hands; a hand is never mirrored

camera_focal.note: MoGe intrinsics are a learned prior; the focal should be calibrated against known geometry (camera_calib.py pnp). A large disagreement needs its explanation in NOTES.md (which one is wrong, and why).

body.text: r0002 exposed a monocular failure: the fitted thumb is 25–33 mm from the white adapter in the critical phases although the silhouette overlaps. I will test opposed distal finger contact and a distal collision term in a workspace copy of the fitter, and check whether they reduce the geometry errors without erasing the observed silhouette and finger motion.

body.summary: Refined camera with stationary adapter observations and added distal finger separation and opposed contact to the MANO fit. Structural check VALID. Scene IoU is 0.888 white and 0.853 black; all annotated phases pass the anatomical contact check.

components.name: scene analysis
components.method: Time-aligned visible phase annotation, MuJoCo rest verification and contact checks
components.note: Fit checks support every major contact phase; actual contact forces and fully hidden geometry are unknown.

components.name: camera
components.method: Background SE(3) plus bounded stationary-adapter reprojection correction
components.note: Mean late support silhouette agreement improved, with remaining single-camera depth uncertainty.

components.name: white adapter geometry and physics
components.method: Blender mesh from station dimensions, distinct blade geometries
components.note: Mass, material and friction use comparable-product and physics assumptions.

components.name: black adapter geometry and physics
components.method: Blender mesh sized from two settled poses under the corrected camera
components.note: Rear features, exact model and dynamics are unresolved.

components.name: object 6D motion
components.method: Support-constrained fitting, prong landmarks and world-space smoothing
components.note: Both rest poses and the dynamic intervals are replayed. Fully occluded poses are marked invalid.

components.name: hand motion
components.method: HaWoR + MANO with distal finger separation and stronger geometry fit
components.note: All supported frames export. The independent self-collision check still fails (26.4%).

components.name: contact phases
components.method: Video annotation with fitted thumb-and-opposing-finger geometry
components.note: Every phase passes nearest-finger and anatomical checks. Contact locations in occluded images are inferred.

components.name: comparison and validation
components.method: Synchronized video, independent triangulated-mesh geometry checks
components.note: Reference contract is VALID. The quality report flags hand self-intersection, several hand continuity jumps and black penetration.

limitations: The independent triangle self-intersection check still fails on 26.4% of supported hand frames. Black contact penetration reaches 8.97 mm. Four frames have discontinuous finger bend estimates.
